content.title: Justin Bieber serenades superfan Billie Eilish during Coachella weekend 2 set
content.text: She’s one less lonely girl. Justin Bieber serenaded superfan Billie Eilish during his Coachella 2026 weekend two performance in Indio, California. Per a video shared online, the “Birds of a Feather” singer crawled up the stage and sat on a chair as the “Baby” crooner sang his 2009 hit “One Less Lonely Girl” to her midway through his set. Justin Bieber serenaded superfan Billie Eilish (as seen above) during Coachella 2026 weekend two. Coachella/Instagram The “Birds of a Feather” singer (seen holding Bieber’s hand) crawled up the stage and sat on a chair. Coachella/Instagram Eilish couldn’t contain her excitement as Bieber, 32, placed his arm around her and hugged her from behind. “Only you, shawty,” Bieber said as he concluded his performance. The pop stars embraced before Eilish, 24, took off running back into the crowd. The “Happier Than Ever” songstress has been a longtime fan of Bieber — even having her wall covered in posters of the hitmaker when she was a young girl. The “Baby” crooner sang his 2009 hit “One Less Lonely Girl” to Eilish (as seen above). Coachella/Instagram Eilish (seen crouching above with Bieber) couldn’t hold her excitement. The first time Eilish met the “Peaches” singer in person was at Coachella in 2019 and the pair later collaborated on the remix to her song “Bad Guy.” Bieber also brought off several other stars for his final Coachella set, including rappers Big Sean and Sexyy Red. The two-time Grammy winner also brought out SZA, and the two musicians led a duet to her 2022 hit “Snooze.” The “Happier Than Ever” songstress (seen above with Bieber posters on her wall) has been a longtime fan of the “Peaches” crooner. lilbieber/instagram Following Bieber’s second Coachella performance (seen above), rumors surfaced that he may be prepping to go on tour. Coachella/Instagram Bieber told the “Broken Clocks” singer, 36, he loved her “so much” before she confessed she was so nervous that she didn’t know how to get off the stage. Following Bieber’s second Coachella performance, rumors surfaced that he may be prepping to go on tour.
